card: Updates stale comments in the http_request fuzz test harness to accurately reflect request handling behavior introduced by #36174. The existing comment claimed completed requests are always returned to worker threads, which is no longer true when send buffers are full. This is a comment-only documentation cleanup in test code with no behavioral changes.
evidence: Commit message and description explain that completed requests now remain in `m_req` when the send buffer exceeds `MAX_BODY_SIZE` after #36174, making the previous comment incorrect.
problem: Comments in the `http_request` fuzz target incorrectly describe request-lifecycle behavior after buffer throttling was introduced, misleading developers reading the test harness.

risk.why: The change only modifies comments in a fuzz test target and does not affect compiled behavior.

summary: Updates outdated code comments in the `http_request` fuzz test harness. It corrects a comment stating that completed requests are always returned to a worker (which changed in #36174 when send-buffer throttling was introduced) and removes an obsolete historical note about `ReadBody()`.
